stem: An analyst reports the CAC payback of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, as sales and marketing expense / new-business MRR, with no gross margin. What does this do to the result?

options.text: Nothing changes, since margin applies to spend and MRR alike
It turns the result from a number of months into an amount in euros
It shows payback as shorter than it is, since not all MRR is gross profit
It shows payback as longer than it is, since gross margin is below 100%
